w01-intro.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Meet HigherSquare 360: one system to run your finance, sales, purchasing, inventory and people, with industry modules you switch on when you need them.

w02-pricing.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|It all starts on our website. HigherSquare 360 brings your finance, sales and teams into one place, so everyone works from the same numbers.

w02b-plans.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Pricing is simple and up front. Choose monthly or annual billing, and see exactly how many users and which modules each plan includes.

w02c-mobile.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|You can even preview the mobile app before you sign up.

w03-register.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Signing up takes about a minute. Pick a plan, here the Business plan, with a fourteen-day free trial.

w03b-business.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Enter your business name, and your workspace address is filled in and checked for you.

w03c-country.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Choose your industry and country. The currency, taxes and chart of accounts are set up to match.

w03d-contact.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Add your name, work email and a password, accept the terms, and create your workspace.

w04-first-login.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Your workspace is ready straight away. Sign in, and you land on your own dashboard, ready for your first customers, products and invoices.

w05-bridge.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Now let's step into a company that has been running on HigherSquare 360 for a few months.

w06-dashboard.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|The dashboard shows the whole business at a glance. The executive highlights show portfolio value, receivables, and your net result for the period.

w06b-charts.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Charts compare what you billed with what you collected, and age what customers still owe. Alerts flag anything that needs your attention.

w06c-search.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|And global search finds any customer, item or document in a second.

w07-sales.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Sales flows from quote, to sales order, to invoice, and each step carries over to the next, so nothing is typed twice.

w07b-invoices.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|The invoices page shows what you invoiced this year, what is outstanding, and what is overdue.

w07c-new.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Here we raise a new invoice. Pick the customer, describe the work, enter the quantity and price, and choose the tax. The totals are worked out for you.

w07d-issue.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Save and issue it, and the invoice is numbered, posted to the general ledger, and ready to print or email with your branding.

w08-receivables.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|When the customer pays, record the receipt, and see every receipt in one list.

w08b-customer.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Open the customer to see their total sales, what they owe, their payment terms, and the full history of invoices and receipts.

w09-purchasing.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Purchasing follows the same path. A requisition asks for what is needed.

w09b-po.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|It becomes a purchase order to the supplier, with every line tracked from ordered, to received, to billed.

w09c-receive.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Goods receipts bring the stock in, and supplier bills are matched and scheduled for payment.

w09d-stock.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Stock on hand shows every item by warehouse, with quantity, average cost and value, updated by every receipt and every sale.

w10-finance.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Finance is built in, not bolted on. Here is the chart of accounts, and the journals that every sale, purchase and payroll posts automatically.

w10b-reports.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Reports are always up to date: the trial balance, the income statement and the balance sheet, for any period, in a click.

w10c-budgets.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Set budgets for the year, and compare them with what actually happened.

w11-approvals.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Approvals keep you in control. Anyone can request approval for a purchase, a payment or an expense,

w11b-submit.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|and it waits for the right person's sign-off, on the web or on their phone.

w12-hr.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|HR and payroll live in the same place. Every employee has a record with their role, their department and their pay.

w12b-leave.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Attendance and leave are tracked day by day, and leave requests go through approval.

w12c-payroll.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Payroll runs every month in a few clicks. Each run shows gross pay, deductions and net pay for every employee, and posts straight to the books.

w13d-pos.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|The point of sale terminal sells at the counter, from your live product list and stock.

w13e-crm.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|CRM follows every lead and opportunity through your sales pipeline.

w13f-manufacturing.fingerprint: en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural|+0%|Manufacturing plans bills of materials and work orders.
